content:
Apple today released the iOS 27 fifth beta and related updates, but also unexpectedly rolled out a second wave of betas, including iOS 26.6.1, macOS 26.6.2, and other system updates.

iOS 26.6.1, iPadOS 26.6.1, and macOS 26.6.2 betas officially arrive

If you've been running Apple's beta software, you have two choices today.

The iOS 27 fifth beta has finally arrived after a three-week wait, marking the beginning of Apple's summer-long preparation for the next major system release.

However, Apple has also just released a new round of betas for iOS 26 and related updates.

The first betas of iOS 26.6.1, iPadOS 26.6.1, and macOS 26.6.2 are now available.

It's rare for Apple to offer betas for such minor updates. Typically, the company pushes small updates directly without any preview.

These updates may replace larger releases like iOS 26.7. But regardless of the reason, Apple clearly felt the need to test these new iOS 26 updates before releasing them publicly.

iOS 26.6.1 and related updates are expected to contain only security patches and bug fixes. We'll keep reporting if we spot any specific changes.

Heads up: if you've already updated your iPhone to the iOS 27 beta, you won't see the option to install iOS 26.6.1. That version is only for devices still running iOS 26.

Are you still on iOS 26? Have you noticed anything different in the iOS 26.6.1 beta? Let us know in the comments.
